title: Connection governance
description: Purpose-built frozen fixtures exercising connection governance directly: add / retire / privacy_change AND their undo + refusal paths; a rejected operation (grant missing the action type → no effect, active list byte-identical before/after); no-implicit-retirement of a broken entry (absent key_env stays active with a typed missing_env problem); and secrets-absent. NOT a reuse of the e2e journey's mutation ordering and NOT the ephemeral output/cp2 gate artifacts.

frozen_inputs.fake_endpoint: http://127.0.0.1:9/v1 (loopback, no listener, never called; NetworkGuard asserts 0 socket/urlopen calls)

governance_chain.expected: every mutation produces an L3 a_* record; the succession chain links verify (allocated.superseded_by=successor, successor.superseded_by=restored); privacy undo succeeds by minting a further record (no in-place edit, ids immutable)

add_undo.step: undo(add) on a freshly added, still-active connection
add_undo.expected: undo retires the allocated id; L3 record carries the undo result

rejected_operation.mechanism: a separate L3 engine whose grant covers only connection.add is asked to retire
rejected_operation.expected: L3 refuses; the active connection list is byte-identical before and after the rejection

no_implicit_retirement.mechanism: declare a connection whose key_env names an absent environment variable
no_implicit_retirement.expected: the record stays ACTIVE in L5's store; connections.normalise reports usable=False with a typed missing_env:<NAME> problem; the shell never auto-retires a broken entry

secrets_absent.mechanism: a sentinel VALUE is set in os.environ; only the env-var NAME crosses the boundary as key_env
secrets_absent.expected: the sentinel VALUE appears in NO file under the L5 or L3 stores and in NO record; the env-var NAME is retained in both

headline_result_recomputed_by_spine: L3 records for all mutations; succession chain links verified from raw L5 models/data.jsonl; rejected operation leaves the active list unchanged; broken entry stays active with a typed problem; secret VALUE absent; L5 models chain verifies; zero network calls.
